title: Short-Stay Share: Damage Addition from HostCover Property-Damage Claims (Listings)
content:
# Short-Stay Share — Damage Addition

*Allowance schedule for Roamhaven Listings, read against the listing's Host Damage Protection (HostCover) claims.*

**Rule.** When the short-stay cleaning fee of a listing is saved, the Host Damage Protection (HostCover) claims in the property damage category that the claims team approved and that were filed on the listing within the last twenty-four months (fewer than twenty-four whole months before the day of the save, counted from the date part of the filing moment) are counted:

| Approved property-damage HostCover claims filed on the listing in that window | Added to the listing's short-stay share |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 0.10 |
| exactly 1 | 0.05 |
| none | nothing |

## Counting cases (hypothetical claim histories, save on 2026-06-15)

| Claims on the listing | Counted | Damage addition |
|---|---|---|
| approved property-damage claims filed 2025-02-03 and 2026-01-20 | 2 | 0.10 |
| one approved property-damage claim filed 2024-06-16 | 1 | 0.05 — fewer than twenty-four whole months back |
| one approved property-damage claim filed 2024-06-15 | 0 | nothing — twenty-four whole months back is outside the window |
| one denied property-damage claim, one approved pet-damage claim | 0 | nothing |
